Booking a Flight or Train Ticket

From the ORA eTraining module "Travel on Sponsored Projects: From Approval to Reimbursement" (lesson 2 of 8).
Flight & Train Costs
Travel Form (TL) Required
A Travel Authorization (TL) Form is required to book a flight or train ticket. Please submit with enough lead time to allow for form approval and processing. The steps to submit a TL form are outlined later in this module.
Using Globetrotter
Globetrotter (1-888-337-2462) is the State of Maryland travel agency. We must utilize Globetrotter to book any flight or train ticket needed on University travel. Call them to get a quote for your flight so you have a reasonable estimate of the expected flight cost. You may also look up your preferred flight online to estimate your flight costs.
Traveler Info
When calling Globetrotter to book a flight be sure you have the traveler's full legal name, birthdate, and contact phone number. Additionally, collect frequent flier or reward account numbers from the traveler so they are applied to the fare.
Fly America Act
The Fly America Act (49 USC 40118) requires federally funded travelers to use US flag air carriers whenever possible, even when cheaper options are available. Make sure you verify this act is adhered to by Globetrotter when making arrangements.
Baggage Fees
Check with your chosen airline to determine what baggage fees may apply for your flight. Any such charges should be included under "Portage" on the MSU Travel Form.

Knowledge check: Knowledge Check A faculty member has an international trip planned to Iceland for a conference. An American Airlines ticket will cost $750 while an Icelandic Air flight will only cost $390. The PI wants to use the Icelandic Air flight to save money for their grant. Is this allowable?
  - Yes  [incorrect]
  - No  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  If correct: Great Job! With the Fly America Act we are required to use American-operated airlines for federally funded travel.
  If incorrect: Remember the Fly America Act? When using federal funds we must use American-operated airlines.
  Note on "Yes": Great Job! Due to the Fly America Act we must choose an American-operated airline even when they may be the more expensive option.
  Note on "No": Remember the Fly America Act? We must use American carriers when traveling using federal funds.
